svg.title: Perennos DEAD AIR. Nobody should find out their stream died from a comment at 3 a.m.
svg.desc: A papel picado banner whose cut pattern is a live audio waveform flutters above a calavera built from broadcast gear. The waveform flatlines, the banner goes still, the colour-bar eyes turn signal red, and the alert log records the dead air.
svg.text: Nobody should find out their stream died
